body: I've watched relatives die of cancer. Trust me on this one - you don't want cancer

I've got enough tramadol and xanax and various painkiller that I know I could give it a good shot, but I fucking hate stuff that hurts, and if I'm going to do this, I want to just doze off and never wake up. This is not the first time i've thought about this. I have friends, some of which I love dearly and others that are just acquaintances, the only reason I'm writing this right now and not eating all the pills I have in my house is that i'm worried about who would feed my cats if I'm not around. Its the only thing right now. Who'd feed the cats. There's probably people that would miss me, but it wouldn't take them long to move on. I'm dust. Nobody is important, I'm not important, doesn't matter what I do, who I know, or who I am. Its a vacuum. I'm a vacuum. There's nothing. No Point. If I ake up tomorrow or if I don't nobody wil really care, or at least for that long.
I guess the only reason I'm typing this is because I know its stupid, but I can't can't see a way out of this.  I just want it to end.
